cards.ex: I really need to crack the books if I want to ace this final exam.
cards.exUz: Agar men bu yakuniy imtihondan a'lo baho olmoqchi bo'lsam, men haqiqatan ham qattiq o'qishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Imtihon yoki sinovga tayyorlanish uchun qattiq va ko'p o'qish.

cards.ex: I need to bone up on my algebra before the test on Friday.
cards.exUz: Juma kuni test bo'lishidan oldin algebrani takrorlab olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Unutilgan bilimlarni yangilash, biror narsani tezda o'rganish.

cards.ex: He learned the hard way that skipping classes has consequences.
cards.exUz: U dars qoldirishning oqibatlari borligini qiyin yo'l bilan o'rgandi.
cards.uzDef: Xatolardan saboq olib, qiyinchilik bilan o'rganish.

cards.ex: She rose to the challenge and completed the project ahead of schedule.
cards.exUz: U qiyinchilikka bardosh berdi va loyihani muddatidan oldin tugatdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vazifani muvaffaqiyatli bajarishga tayyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: Students who read during the summer get a head start in the fall.
cards.exUz: Yozda kitob o'qiydigan talabalar kuzda erta boshlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan oldin boshlash, afzallikka ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The new teacher hit the ground running on her first day.
cards.exUz: Yangi o'qituvchi birinchi kuniyoq darhol ishga kirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi vazifani darhol energiya va g'ayrat bilan boshlash.

cards.ex: The students are burning the midnight oil to finish their research papers.
cards.exUz: Talabalar tadqiqot ishlarini tugatish uchun tunni bedor o'tkazmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Kechgacha yoki tungacha qattiq ishlash yoki o'qish.

cards.ex: The school cut corners on supplies, which affected the quality of education.
cards.exUz: Maktab ta'minotda yo'lni qisqartirdi, bu ta'lim sifatiga ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Tezroq yoki arzonroq qilish uchun standartlardan chetga chiqish.

cards.ex: She learned the poem by rote, without really understanding its meaning.
cards.exUz: U she'rni ma'nosini tushunmasdan, shunchaki yodlab o'rgandi.
cards.uzDef: Tushunmasdan, shunchaki yodlash orqali o'rganish.

cards.ex: Although the project failed, it was a valuable learning experience for everyone involved.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lgan bo'lsa ham, u ishtirok etganlarning barchasi uchun qimmatli o'rganish tajribasi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan saboq olish, o'rganish uchun imkoniyat.

cards.ex: He has a lot of book knowledge, but lacks practical experience.
cards.exUz: U kitob bilimiga ega, lekin amaliy tajribasi yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Kitoblardan olingan nazariy bilimlar, amaliy emas.

cards.ex: I'm so relieved I managed to pass the test!
cards.exUz: Men testdan o'tganimdan juda xursandman!
cards.uzDef: Testda muvaffaqiyatli natijaga erishmoq.

cards.ex: The lecture was so mind-numbing that I almost fell asleep.
cards.exUz: Ma'ruza shunchalik aqlni zeriktiruvchi ediki, deyarli uxlab qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Juda zerikarli va diqqatni jamlash qiyin bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: He's always been at the top of the class in mathematics.
cards.exUz: U har doim matematikada sinfning eng yaxshisi bo'lgan.
cards.uzDef: Sinfda eng yaxshi natijalarga erishgan o'quvchi.

cards.ex: Failing the exam was a wake-up call; I knew I had to study harder.
cards.exUz: Imtihondan yiqilish meni ogohlantirdi; Men qattiqroq o'qishim kerakligini bildim.
cards.uzDef: Xato yoki muammo haqida ogohlantiruvchi voqea yoki vaziyat.

cards.ex: The teacher encouraged us to think outside the box when solving the problem.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi bizni muammoni hal qilishda standartdan tashqari fikrlashga undadi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi, ijodiy yechimlarni topishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The teacher always goes the extra mile to help her students succeed.
cards.exUz: O'qituvchi har doim o'quvchilarining muvaffaqiyatiga erishishlariga yordam berish uchun qo'shimcha harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Talab qilinadiganidan ko'proq harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: He needs to get his act together and start attending classes regularly.
cards.exUz: U o'zini tutishi va darslarga muntazam qatnashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tartibli va mas'uliyatli bo'lishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I passed the exam by the skin of my teeth.
cards.exUz: Men imtihondan zo'rg'a o'tdim.
cards.term: by the skin of your teeth
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin oraliqda, qiyinchilik bilan muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: He needs to straighten up and fly right if he wants to graduate.
cards.exUz: Agar u bitirmoqchi bo'lsa, u to'g'ri yo'lga tushishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatti-harakatini yaxshilash va to'g'ri ish qilish.

cards.ex: The professor droned on for two hours about a topic no one understood.
cards.exUz: Professor ikki soat davomida hech kim tushunmagan mavzu haqida zerikarli tarzda gapirdi.
cards.uzDef: Zerikarli tarzda uzoq vaqt gapirish.

cards.ex: She studied hard and aced the chemistry test.
cards.exUz: U qattiq o'qidi va kimyo testidan a'lo baho oldi.
cards.uzDef: Imtihonda juda yuqori ball olish.

cards.ex: He was caught playing truant and had to face the consequences.
cards.exUz: U dars qoldirganligi uchun ushlandi va oqibatlarga duch keldi.
cards.uzDef: Ruxsatsiz maktabni qoldirmoq.

cards.ex: Getting into that university is going to be a tough row to hoe.
cards.exUz: Ushbu universitetga kirish juda qiyin ish bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Bajarish juda qiyin bo'lgan vazifa.

cards.ex: The experiment failed, so it's back to the drawing board.
cards.exUz: Tajriba muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun hammasini boshidan boshlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Reja yoki yechim ishlamasa, yangi reja tuzish.

cards.ex: He had to work his way through college to pay for tuition.
cards.exUz: U o'qish uchun pul to'lash uchun kollejda o'qishni o'zi to'lashi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: O'qish xarajatlarini ishlash orqali qoplamoq.

cards.ex: I find I learn best by doing, not just reading about it.
cards.exUz: Men buni faqat o'qishdan ko'ra, amalda bajarish orqali yaxshiroq o'rganishimni bilaman.
cards.uzDef: Nazariyadan ko'ra amaliyot orqali o'rganish.

cards.ex: It's hard to keep up with all the reading assignments in this class.
cards.exUz: Ushbu sinfdagi barcha o'qish topshiriqlariga bardosh berish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Darslardagi yuklamalarga bardosh berish, topshiriqlarni o'z vaqtida bajarish

cards.ex: I studied for hours, but when I took the test, I drew a blank.
cards.exUz: Men soatlab o'qidim, lekin testdan o'tganimda hech narsani eslay olmadim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani eslay olmaslik, xotiradan o'chirilgan.

cards.ex: The professor relied on the chalk and talk method, which some students found a bit dry.
cards.exUz: Professor "doskada tushuntirish" usuliga tayandi, bu ba'zi talabalarga biroz zerikarli tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: O'qituvchi doskada yozib va gapirib dars o'tishi usuli.
